column1: # S20: corpus samples the replay gates leave out (tools/replay_corpus.py load_index: Mull, tools/replay_all.sh,
# tools/linecov.py). Kept in the corpus (not deleted: the user's rule); each line: sample path, function, reason.
# The 15 synthetic samples below were recorded in S17 / S18, before S19 defined a fresh guest stack frame as zero
# (sh4_ops.h sh4_stack_lowered, hw.c hw_stack_alloc). The replay judges today's side B against the side A recorded
# then (difftest.c --hwreplay does not re-run the original): their side A read stack words no code had written, which
# held what earlier code left in the snapshot; today's side B reads zeros there.
# S21 proof (DECOMP 22.2): a debug build of the hand side with sh4_stack_lowered's clearing turned off (nothing else
# changed) passes all 15 (hw replay done 15 failed 0); the normal build fails each. The never-written words:
# - the racer cameras' and the title intro's 7 (8c03cbc2, 8c01bef8, 8c03c99c, 8c03c804): stale slots of their frames
# - type 0x30's pose's 8 (8c05e098, actor_type30_pose_node): its PoseFrame's pos / ang / scl, which the original fills
#   by nj_MotionStepA / B / C; this port's HLE answers those three with h_default (r0 = 0, nothing written), so the
#   frame keeps the snapshot's leftovers on side A and zeros on side B; a zero scale then gives XF0-XF3 = 0 (side B),
#   a leftover one a matrix (side A); s18n5's: XF4 -0 / +0 from a zero against a leftover angle.
# The same five functions have fresh samples recorded under the defined stack (S19's s19re, S20's s20re / s20re2 / s20re3)
